title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
title_zh: 面向自演化多智能体系统的拓扑一致性

paragraphs.en: Complex tasks inherently couple workflow structure, agent responsibility, collaboration, and memory access: task regions delimit responsibility and tool scope, cross-region dependencies give rise to handoffs, and ownership boundaries delimit private and selectively shared memory. Existing methods can jointly optimize agent and communication structures, yet such optimization does not by itself require responsibility, handoff, and memory boundaries to remain consistent with task dependencies. We term this requirement topological coherence . We introduce ToCoMAS , a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System . ToCoMAS grounds a task graph in tool interfaces, organizes compatible task nodes into reusable responsibility domains, and derives dependency-induced and profile-conditioned collaboration together with boundary-regulated memory visibility. During online self-evolution, ToCoMAS proposes coupled changes to agent, collaboration, and memory policies, retaining for subsequent tasks only candidates that satisfy structural constraints and improve evaluated reward. Across BBEH, WorkBench, SWE-Bench-Verified, and CoMemBench, ToCoMAS improves task success over baselines across backbones. CoMemBench also shows gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified progress, handoffs, and memory isolation.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂任务本质上将工作流程结构、智能体职责、协作和记忆访问耦合在一起：任务区域界定职责和工具范围，跨区域依赖关系引发交接，而所有权边界则划分了私有记忆与选择性共享记忆。 现有方法能够联合优化智能体和通信结构，但此类优化本身并不要求职责、交接和记忆边界必须与任务依赖关系保持一致。 我们将这一要求称为“拓扑一致性”。 我们提出了 ToCoMAS，即一种拓扑一致的多智能体系统。 ToCoMAS 以工具接口为基础构建任务图，将兼容的任务节点组织为可重用的职责域，并推导出由依赖关系引发的、受配置条件约束的协作机制，以及由边界调控的记忆可见性。 在线自我演化过程中，ToCoMAS 会提出对智能体、协作和记忆策略的联合调整，仅保留那些满足结构约束并能提升评估奖励的候选方案，供后续任务使用。 在 BBEH、WorkBench、SWE-Bench-Verified 和 CoMemBench 等基准测试中，ToCoMAS 相较于基线模型在各种基础架构上均提升了任务成功率。 CoMemBench 的结果还显示，ToCoMAS 在验证进展、交接次数和记忆隔离方面优于自我演化基线模型。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems (MAS) provide a general framework for combining specialized reasoning, tool use, and interaction policies ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Conversational and role-based systems such as CAMEL, AutoGen, and AgentVerse ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) , together with peer review, debate, MetaGPT, and ChatDev ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) , make increasingly complex tasks accessible. This progress also turns organization into a central design problem: a MAS must decide which task regions each agent owns, which tools and information it may access, where verification is required, and how local outputs compose into a globally executable process.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）为结合专业推理、工具使用和交互策略提供了一个通用框架（Guo 等人，2024；Li 等人，2024）。 对话式和角色驱动的系统，如 CAMEL、AutoGen 和 AgentVerse（Li 等人，2023；Wu 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2024），以及同行评审、辩论、MetaGPT 和 ChatDev（Xu 等人，2023；Du 等人，2024；Hong 等人，2024；Qian 等人，2024），使得日益复杂的任务变得可行。 这一进展也将组织设计变成了一个核心问题：多智能体系统必须决定每个智能体负责哪些任务区域、可以访问哪些工具和信息、何处需要验证，以及局部输出如何组合成一个全局可执行的过程。

paragraphs.en: Recent work automates these choices by searching computation graphs, agentic programs, or workflows ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) ; adapting communication topology or task orchestration ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Ke et al., 2026 ) ; and retaining structured or decentralized experience ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Hao et al., 2026 ) . Evolutionary methods further generate agents ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . The most comprehensive system-level formulation jointly evolves agent roles, prompts, models, tools, and communication topology, while retaining a candidate pool and experience memory for cross-task reuse ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, task workflows, agent responsibilities, collaboration, and memory remain separately represented structures, without an explicit constraint that keeps their relations compatible as the system changes.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究通过搜索计算图、智能体程序或工作流（Zhuge 等，2024；Hu 等，2025；Zhang 等，2025c）；调整通信拓扑或任务编排（Liu 等，2024；Zhang 等，2025b；Yang 等，2025；Wu 等，2026；Ke 等，2026）；以及保留结构化或去中心化的经验（Zhang 等，2025a；Wang 等，2026；Yang 等，2026；Hao 等，2026），将这些选择自动化了。 进化方法还能进一步生成智能体（Yuan 等，2025）。 最全面的系统级框架会协同演化智能体的角色、提示、模型、工具和通信拓扑，同时保留候选池和经验记忆，以便跨任务复用（Hu 等，2026）。 然而，任务工作流、智能体职责、协作和记忆仍然作为相互独立的结构存在，缺乏明确的约束来确保这些结构在系统变化时保持兼容。

paragraphs.en: Building on this formulation, we propose ToCoMAS , a Topology-Coherent Multi-Agent System that carries this constraint through organization and self-evolution. ToCoMAS maps an upstream-provided task graph to a public tool graph under global operation and dependency constraints, then groups structurally and operationally compatible regions into reusable agent responsibility domains, allowing one agent to own multiple related subgraphs while separating heterogeneous execution semantics. It then derives collaboration and memory coordination from relations among these domains: responsibility ownership delimits local tools and private memory, task-induced adjacency provides dependency-aware handoffs, and boundary policies regulate selective sharing and verifier escalation. Finally, an online controller proposes changes to reusable structural policies and compiles each candidate against the task topology. It reconciles affected ownership, handoff, and memory relations, then retains structurally valid candidates only when their evaluated reward improves on the parent. We evaluate fixed and evolving variants against a direct-call control, prespecified and automatically designed baselines, and a self-evolving baseline across reasoning, tool-use, and software-engineering benchmarks. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一构建方式，我们提出了 ToCoMAS——一个拓扑连贯的多智能体系统，它通过组织结构和自我演化来贯彻这一约束。 ToCoMAS 将上游提供的任务图映射到一个公共工具图中，并遵循全局操作和依赖约束；随后，它将结构上和操作上兼容的区域分组为可重用的智能体责任域，使单个智能体能够管理多个相关的子图，同时分离异构的执行语义。 接着，它从这些域之间的关系中推导出协作与记忆协调机制：责任归属界定了本地工具和私有记忆的边界，任务引发的邻近性提供了依赖感知的交接机制，而边界策略则规范了选择性共享和验证器升级流程。 最后，一个在线控制器会提出对可重用结构策略的修改，并将每个候选方案与任务拓扑进行编译验证。 该控制器会协调受影响的归属、交接和记忆关系，并且仅当候选方案经过评估后的奖励优于其父方案时，才会保留结构上有效的候选方案。 我们在推理、工具使用和软件工程基准测试中，将固定版本和演化版本与直接调用控制方案、预定义及自动设计的基线方案，以及一个自我演化的基线方案进行了对比评估。我们的贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: We formulate topological coherence as a structural constraint that keeps task workflows, agent responsibilities, collaboration interfaces, and memory boundaries consistent during self-evolution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将拓扑一致性定义为一个结构性约束，用于在自我演化过程中保持任务工作流程、智能体职责、协作接口和记忆边界的连贯性。

paragraphs.en: We develop a topology-grounded architecture in which task and tool relations induce reusable agent responsibility domains, dependency-aware and profile-conditioned collaboration, and boundary-regulated memory access; execution feedback guides coupled structural proposals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种基于拓扑结构的架构，其中任务与工具之间的关系能够引导出可重用的智能体责任域、依赖感知且受配置条件约束的协作机制，以及边界受限的记忆访问；执行反馈则用于指导耦合的结构化提案。

paragraphs.en: We establish controlled comparisons with prespecified, automatically designed, and self-evolving MAS baselines to separate architectural gains from evolutionary search.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过预设、自动设计和自我演化的多智能体系统（MAS）基线进行受控比较，以区分架构改进与演化搜索所带来的增益。

paragraphs.en: Early role-based and conversational MAS organize collaboration through role play, proposal aggregation, debate, and peer review ( Li et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Du et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2023 ) ; MetaGPT and ChatDev encode specialized roles in manually specified software-development workflows ( Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) . Automatic design searches optimizable computation graphs (GPTSwarm) ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) , code-defined agentic systems and workflow programs (ADAS and AFlow) ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) , or agents, prompts, and communication structures (AutoAgents, MASS, and ARG-Designer) ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) . MAS-Orchestra adds holistic task-conditioned orchestration ( Ke et al., 2026 ) . These methods move beyond fixed protocols but favor atomic roles or workflow nodes over reusable task-and-tool responsibility domains.

sents.en: Automatic design searches optimizable computation graphs (GPTSwarm) ( Zhuge et al., 2024 ) , code-defined agentic systems and workflow programs (ADAS and AFlow) ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) , or agents, prompts, and communication structures (AutoAgents, MASS, and ARG-Designer) ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
sents.zh: 自动设计方法会搜索可优化的计算图（GPTSwarm）（Zhuge et al., 2024）、由代码定义的智能体系统和流程程序（ADAS 和 AFlow）（Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025c），或智能体、提示和通信结构（AutoAgents、MASS 和 ARG-Designer）（Chen et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026b）。

sents.en: MAS-Orchestra adds holistic task-conditioned orchestration ( Ke et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: MAS-Orchestra 增加了基于任务的全面协调机制（Ke et al., 2026）。

sents.en: These methods move beyond fixed protocols but favor atomic roles or workflow nodes over reusable task-and-tool responsibility domains.
sents.zh: 这些方法突破了固定协议的限制，但更倾向于使用原子化角色或流程节点，而非可重用的任务与工具责任域。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic agent networks adapt participating agents at inference time ( Liu et al., 2024 ) ; G-Designer learns task-aware communication graphs, AgentNet evolves decentralized coordination, and CARD conditions communication topology on dynamic environments ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . Graph-conditioned language models and graph retrieval guide reasoning and information selection ( Tang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) , while topological learning studies local-to-global compatibility through shared incidence and boundaries ( Hansen and Ghrist, 2019 ; Bodnar et al., 2021 ) . In memory organization, G-Memory stores hierarchical collaboration experience, E-mem reconstructs episodic context through local assistants, and PlugMem organizes reusable knowledge in a typed graph ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . Together, these lines support relational reasoning, communication, and memory; they do not, by themselves, jointly derive task ownership, tool authority, required handoffs, and memory visibility from a shared task-and-tool topology.
paragraphs.zh: 动态智能体网络在推理阶段会调整参与的智能体（Liu 等，2024）；G-Designer 学习任务相关的通信图，AgentNet 发展去中心化的协调机制，而 CARD 则将通信拓扑与动态环境相绑定（Zhang 等，2025b；Yang 等，2025；Wu 等，2026）。 图条件语言模型和图检索技术能够引导推理与信息选择（Tang 等，2024；He 等，2024），而拓扑学习研究则通过共享关联关系和边界来探索局部到全局的兼容性（Hansen 和 Ghrist，2019；Bodnar 等，2021）。 在记忆组织方面，G-Memory 存储分层协作经验，E-mem 通过本地助手重建事件性上下文，而 PlugMem 则将可重用的知识以类型化图的形式进行组织（Zhang 等，2025a；Wang 等，2026；Yang 等，2026）。 这些研究共同支持了关系推理、通信和记忆功能；但仅凭它们自身，尚无法从共享的任务与工具拓扑中联合推导出任务归属权、工具使用权限、必要的任务交接以及记忆的可见性范围。

paragraphs.en: Recent self-evolution methods revise organizations using feedback: EvoAgent expands agent populations through mutation and crossover, while DecentMem uses decentralized private memories for agent-level self-evolution ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Hao et al., 2026 ) . EvoMAS, the closest system-level approach, represents a MAS as a structured configuration and jointly evolves agent roles, prompts, model and tool assignments, and communication topology; it also retains a candidate pool and experience memory for cross-task reuse ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Yet co-editing these components does not itself require changes in responsibility to induce compatible agent capabilities, handoffs, and memory permissions after a structural change. ToCoMAS instead enforces topological coherence , deriving agent responsibilities, required handoffs, and memory boundaries from shared task-and-tool regions.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的自我演化方法通过反馈对组织进行修订：EvoAgent 通过变异和交叉来扩展智能体种群，而 DecentMem 则使用去中心化的私有记忆来实现智能体级别的自我演化（Yuan 等人，2025；Hao 等人，2026）。 EvoMAS 是最接近系统级方法的一种，它将多智能体系统表示为一种结构化配置，并协同演化智能体的角色、提示、模型与工具分配以及通信拓扑；它还保留了一个候选池和经验记忆，以便跨任务复用（Hu 等人，2026）。 然而，协同编辑这些组件本身并不需要在结构变化后改变责任划分，以产生兼容的智能体能力、任务交接和记忆权限。 ToCoMAS 则强制实现拓扑一致性，从共享的任务与工具区域中推导出智能体的责任、所需的任务交接以及记忆边界。

paragraphs.en: We present ToCoMAS , a topology-coherent framework for constructing and evolving multi-agent systems. Its central principle is that agent organization, collaboration, and memory should not be designed as independent configuration choices. Instead, they are derived from a common task topology and jointly screened as the system evolves. Given a task graph T q T_{q} and the public tool graph K K , ToCoMAS first grounds every existing task node by a whole-graph map Ψ q \Psi_{q} , without redecomposing the user query. It then forms a quotient topology over responsibility regions, assigns these regions to capable agents, and derives communication and memory boundaries from the same maps. This construction is summarized by:
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ToCoMAS，一个用于构建和演化多智能体系统的拓扑一致性框架。 其核心原则是：智能体的组织、协作与记忆不应被设计为相互独立的配置选项。 相反，它们应从一个共同的任务拓扑中推导出来，并在系统演化过程中共同筛选。 给定一个任务图 T q T_{q} 和公共工具图 K K，ToCoMAS 首先通过全图映射 Ψ q \Psi_{q} 为每个现有任务节点建立基础，而无需重新分解用户查询。 接着，它在责任区域上构建一个商拓扑，将这些区域分配给具备能力的智能体，并从相同的映射中推导出通信与记忆边界。 这一构建过程可概括为：

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. Linux clients access the backbones through OpenAI-compatible APIs; Qwen3.8-27B inference runs on A100 GPUs, while CoMemBench execution uses H800 and A100 workers. Methods share benchmark tasks, tools, and native evaluators; paired CoMemBench variants start from the same source state in isolated workspaces. The fixed ToCoMAS configuration uses organization affinity 0.45 0.45 and memory retrieval k = 3 k=3 ; we vary these over { 0.30 , 0.45 , 0.60 , 0.75 } \{0.30,0.45,0.60,0.75\} and { 1 , 3 , 5 , 8 } \{1,3,5,8\} , respectively. In online structural evolution, a task’s first attempt uses the genome current at launch and supplies its reported score; feedback then proposes one structural candidate, tested on that same task. Accepted changes affect subsequently launched tasks, not the scored attempt. We retain native evaluator receipts, handoff traces, and model-call ledgers for auditing and cost accounting.

paragraphs.en: Topology-coherent organization improves general task performance. paragraphs.en: The gains extend to verified handoffs and information isolation. paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares full ToCoMAS with variants that remove one structural mechanism at a time. Topological Agent Organization assigns connected, tool-compatible task regions to agents; replacing this assignment with canonical-order groups preserves tool coverage but lowers CoMemBench VNCR by 14.33 points. Structure-Adaptive Collaborative Orchestration derives inter-agent handoffs from cross-region task dependencies and checks whether downstream agents can consume the projected artifacts. Boundary-Preserving Memory Coordination restricts retrieval to private records and evidence admitted across responsibility boundaries; making every verified record globally visible reduces ICS by 19.96 points. Finally, Coherence-Constrained Structural Evolution uses task feedback to update the organization for subsequent tasks; retaining a fixed structure reduces WorkBench SR by 6.52 points. Together, these ablations link the three coherence relations to distinct outcomes: responsibility assignment to verified progress, cross-region handoffs to artifact acceptance, and memory boundaries to isolation; online evolution further improves task success.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented ToCoMAS , a topology-coherent architecture for self-evolving multi-agent systems. Rather than specifying agent roles, communication, and memory independently, ToCoMAS grounds task nodes in tool requirements, groups compatible regions into agent responsibilities, and derives handoffs and memory boundaries from the resulting organization. Online evolution compiles structural proposals into task-conditioned organizations and retains improvements that satisfy executable and coherence constraints. Experiments on BBEH, WorkBench, and SWE-Bench-Verified show improved task performance over the evaluated baselines; CoMemBench further reveals gains over the self-evolving baseline in verified node completion, accepted handoffs, and isolation from polluted context. Ablations identify distinct contributions from agent organization, collaborative orchestration, memory coordination, and structural evolution. These results support topological coherence as a guiding principle for organizing and evolving multi-agent systems.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 ToCoMAS——一种适用于自演化多智能体系统的拓扑一致性架构。 ToCoMAS 并未独立指定智能体的角色、通信和记忆，而是将任务节点基于工具需求进行定位，将兼容区域分组为智能体的职责，并根据由此形成的组织结构推导出交接点与记忆边界。 在线演化过程会将结构提案编译为以任务为条件的组织结构，并保留那些满足可执行性与一致性约束的改进方案。 在 BBEH、WorkBench 和 SWE-Bench-Verified 上的实验表明，该架构相比所评估的基线模型在任务表现上有所提升；CoMemBench 进一步显示，在已验证节点的完成度、被接受的交接次数以及免受污染上下文影响的能力方面，相较于自演化基线模型也取得了进步。 消融实验表明，智能体组织、协作调度、记忆协调和结构演化各自对系统性能具有独特的贡献。 这些结果支持将拓扑一致性作为组织与演化多智能体系统的指导原则。

paragraphs.en: CoMemBench ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) provides executable workflows in four domains: stateful tool use, repository code, offline retrieval, and formal mathematics. It contains 800 clean workflows (200 per domain) and 800 matched polluted variants. A workflow specifies a request, canonical task nodes and dependency edges, node-local execution requirements, typed handoff contracts, resources, and a domain-native evaluator. Dependency edges represent required task relations, not predefined agent communication edges. Verified node receipts and artifact-exposure records support the progress and handoff metrics below. In a matched polluted variant, one contextually inapplicable artifact is added to a target consumer’s incoming artifact view; the query, graph, initial state, tools, and non-target inputs remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: CoMemBench（Zhao 等人，2026）提供了四个领域的可执行工作流：状态化工具使用、仓库代码、离线检索和形式化数学。 它包含 800 个纯净工作流（每个领域 200 个）以及 800 个匹配的污染变体。 一个工作流指定了请求、标准任务节点和依赖边、节点本地的执行要求、类型化的移交契约、资源以及一个领域特定的评估器。 依赖边表示必需的任务关系，而非预定义的智能体通信边。 经过验证的节点收据和产物暴露记录支持下方的进度与移交指标。 在一个匹配的污染变体中，会向目标消费者的输入产物视图中添加一个在上下文中不适用产物；查询、图、初始状态、工具以及非目标输入保持不变。
